reviewDecisions.rationale: Imported-fiber access is a measurable upstream state that can precede downstream margin/price differentiation and directly tests V1.6 outside agriculture.
Record May volumes provide a clean positive physical-control case against the new state-variable mechanism.
A concrete demand shock tests whether long-run structural narratives are incorrectly allowed to override current fundamentals.
A clear product-cycle state provides a non-agricultural negative control and guards against generic semiconductor-theme substitution.
Technical standard completion is important but should not be confused with supplier revenue conversion.
Scheduled index flows deliberately test the distinction between price demand and company fundamentals.
